// diagnostic

E-SUBJECT-CALL

A bare member chain cannot be used as a value of type {expected} here

What

A bare member chain cannot be used as a value of type {expected} here

Why

Lower-case `.member` is shorthand only for a one-parameter callable; this argument expects an ordinary value

Fix

Write a value of type {expected}, or use `(subject: {expected}) -> subject{chain}`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-SUBJECT-CALL: tests/ui/bare_member_value_argument.stderr.

Error [E-SUBJECT-CALL]: A bare member chain cannot be used as a value of type ?Int here
  --> tests/ui/bare_member_value_argument.jet:4:11
    |
  4 |     need(.active)
    |           ^^^^^^
 Why: lower-case `.member` is shorthand only for a one-parameter callable; this argument expects an ordinary value
 Fix: write a value of type ?Int, or use `(subject: ?Int) -> subject.active`
